summary: Frontend E2E testing of Site em Construção (maintenance mode). All 10 scenarios in the review request verified successfully on the HTTPS preview URL. Baseline OFF shows storefront; admin can toggle ON via /admin/site (dialog accepted); anonymous incognito context correctly sees UnderConstruction page on /, /produtos, /produto/<slug>; /login and /admin remain accessible during maintenance; countdown renders 4 units; WhatsApp/Instagram buttons have target=_blank rel=noopener noreferrer; /em-construcao?preview=1 works; toggling OFF + save immediately reverts for fresh anon visitor; customer role redirected away from /admin. Boot splash (data-testid boot-splash) detected during initial load, no flash-of-storefront observed. Maintenance is left DISABLED at end.
critical_code_review_comments: MaintenanceGate.js correctly fails open on /site-status error (setStatus({maintenance_enabled:false})) — good resilience.
AdminSite.js sends launch_date as null when empty and trims URL fields to null — matches backend URL validation expectations.

UnderConstruction useCountdown recomputes via useMemo based on Date.now() interval — fine, though it's a minor unnecessary re-render every second when show_countdown=false with launchDate set (guarded correctly by early-return); no action needed.
